measures.what_it_does: Authorizes Adams County Fire Protection District No. 4 (Harder-McCall), a small rural district voting in the Ritzville Rural SE precinct, to levy a one-year special property tax for the construction, maintenance and operation of its pumper equipment in 2027. Needs 60% yes.
measures.cost_line: $11,000, an estimated $0.42 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $126 on a $300,000 property), collected in 2027; the same amount as the district's 2024 and 2025 special levies.
measures.pro_summary: No statement for was filed. The district has asked for, and won, this levy every year: 7-0 in 2022, 4-0 in 2023, 9-0 in 2024 and 6-1 in 2025.
measures.con_summary: No statement against was filed and no committee formed.

taxes.basis: A yes vote continues the district's yearly $11,000 special levy at the same dollar amount; it is not a new or larger tax.

measures.sources_note: VoteWA voters' guide record 7368 (S1); sample ballot (S2); SOS November 2022-2025 precinct exports (S3-S6); DOR levy detail for taxes due 2025 and 2024 (S7-S8); PDC query (S9).

measures.what_it_does: Authorizes Adams County Park and Recreation District No. 2 (Washtucna) to levy a one-year special property tax for the maintenance and operation of the Washtucna Pool in 2027. Needs 60% yes; the same levy drew 57.4% yes in the August 2026 primary.
measures.cost_line: $85,000, an estimated $0.83 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $249 on a $300,000 property), collected in 2027. DOR recorded a $50,000 levy for 2024 and none for 2025; voters approved $80,000 in August 2025.
measures.pro_summary: No statement for was filed. Voters approved the district's pool levy with 60% or more in November 2023 (60.5%) and August 2025 (68.2%); in 2025 the pool board said the long-closed, leaking pool needed about $98,000 in repairs to reopen. This measure is for maintenance and operation, not repair.
measures.con_summary: No statement against was filed and no committee formed. The levy fell short of 60% in November 2022 (51.4%), November 2024 (57.1%) and August 2026 (57.4%).

taxes.basis: A yes vote approves a one-year pool levy that the district has put to voters most years; at $85,000 it is about the $80,000 voters approved in August 2025 (DOR has not yet confirmed a 2026 levy) and above the $50,000 DOR last recorded, but it is a yearly special levy, not a new tax or a lid lift.

measures.sources_note: VoteWA voters' guide record 7371 (S1); sample ballot (S2); VoteWA 2026 primary results (S3); SOS precinct exports 2022-2025 (S4-S7); DOR levy detail 2024 and 2025 (S8-S9); Ritzville Adams County Journal July 2025 (S10); PDC query (S11).
